# Zephaniah Chapter 1 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A) | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ZEP_001_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**1:1** The-word of-YHWH which came [hayah] to Tsefanyah [Zephaniah] son of-Kushi, son of-Gedalyah, son of-Amaryah, son of-Chizkiyyah [Hezekiah], in-the-days of-Yo'shiyyahu [Josiah] son of-Amon, king of-Yehudah.

**1:14** Near [qarov] [is] the-great [ha-gadol] day of-YHWH — near and-hastening [maher] greatly [me'od]; the-sound [qol] of-the-day of-YHWH [is] bitter [mar]; there a-warrior [gibbor] cries-out [tsore'ach sham].

**1:15** A-day of-wrath [evrah] [is] that day [ha-yom ha-hu], a-day of-distress [tsarah] and-anguish [u-metsuqah], a-day of-ruin [sho'ah] and-devastation [u-mesho'ah], a-day of-darkness [choshekh] and-gloom [va-afelah], a-day of-cloud [anan] and-thick-darkness [va-arafel].

---

Zephaniah 1 — part of the Book of the Twelve (Minor Prophets).
